evals.prompt: Quiero que la app tenga un dashboard donde vea cuánto llevo gastado por categoría este mes comparado con mi presupuesto.
evals.expected_output: El asistente explora el contexto del proyecto, hace preguntas de clarificación (una a la vez) sobre alcance/criterios de éxito, y NO escribe código ni un spec hasta tener aprobación explícita.
expectations: The assistant does not write or propose actual application code implementing the dashboard in its turn-1 response
The assistant does not create a spec file under docs/ in this turn
The assistant asks at least one clarifying question about scope, data source, or success criteria before proposing a full design
The assistant's response ends by explicitly asking for the user's confirmation/approval rather than assuming it and moving on
If more than one clarifying question is needed, the assistant asks only one per message rather than listing several at once

evals.prompt: ¿Cómo deberíamos manejar las transacciones recurrentes, tipo Netflix o el gym, para que no tenga que categorizarlas cada mes a mano?
evals.expected_output: El asistente propone 1-3 enfoques con trade-offs (o primero clarifica alcance), presenta un diseño breve y pide aprobación explícita antes de proponer implementación.
expectations: The assistant does not write or propose actual application code in its turn-1 response
The assistant does not create a spec file under docs/ in this turn
The assistant proposes 1-3 approaches with trade-offs (or first asks a clarifying question if the request is still too open), leading with a recommendation
The assistant's response ends by explicitly asking for approval before proceeding, rather than proceeding directly into an implementation plan
If more than one clarifying question is needed, the assistant asks only one per message rather than listing several at once

evals.prompt: Necesito poder importar mis movimientos bancarios desde un CSV y que la app intente categorizarlos automáticamente.
evals.expected_output: El asistente clarifica formato/alcance, presenta diseño con trade-offs para la categorización automática, y se detiene a esperar aprobación sin tocar código ni crear el spec todavía.
expectations: The assistant does not write or propose actual application code (e.g. a CSV parser or categorization algorithm) in its turn-1 response
The assistant does not create a spec file under docs/ in this turn
The assistant asks about scope/format details (e.g. CSV format, bank, categorization rules) and/or presents approaches with trade-offs for auto-categorization before finalizing a design
The assistant's response ends by explicitly asking for approval before proceeding, rather than proceeding directly into an implementation plan
If more than one clarifying question is needed, the assistant asks only one per message rather than listing several at once
